what: White-bordered photos stack one by one at the panel center — the first lands from 100px below at -8° in 1.2s easeOutQuart, the rest settle at staggered left/right positions (up 120→50px · sideways ±200→60px) and ±5° at .18s intervals over .7s easeOutCubic. The last one rises from 60px below with .2s easeInQuart · 1s easeOutQuart, fills the panel in .8s easeOutQuart, and the border disappears in .2s (fx:open · fx:done)

options.lead: Duration for the first section to settle (sec), default 1.2
options.each: Gap between sections (seconds), default .18 — the last section comes each×7.5 after the second
options.rise: Duration for the last section to rise (s), default 1
options.grow: Duration for the last sheet to fill the board (sec), default .8
options.tilt: Tilt of the staggered sheets (deg), default 5
options.spread: Staggered distance multiplier, default 1 — distance scales proportionally to a 470px dummy width
options.--fx-w: Dummy width (css variable), default 470px — 280px on phone
options.[data-fx-part=pile]: Dummy frame (child) — photos are stacked inside
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Stacked photos (child, multiple) — first one at the bottom
options.[data-fx-part=last]: Section that rises last to fill the panel (optional child) — continues as the first slide of the hero slider

note: The original sets a fixed tilt per section (8° · 6.5° · -9° …) on each photo and moves the wrapping frame — if the user applies rotate to an element inside photo, the same overlap results. The fill produces the same values as the original CSS keyframes (width · height 100%) via GSAP.

from.where: index.html .hm-main (hero — original pageTopLoad’s nine .img-first and .img-last, once filled, a slick fade slideshow)
